title: Creative/Graphic Designer
minimumQualification: Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Multimedia, or a related field (preferred)
jobDescription:
ROLE:
- Creative Design: Design high-quality marketing assets for global campaigns across digital and print platforms
- Digital Assets: Create banners, emailers, social media creatives, presentations, and other marketing collateral
- Regional Adaptation: Customize and localize creatives for APAC, EMEA, and AMS regions while maintaining consistency
- Brand Compliance: Ensure all deliverables align with brand guidelines and regulatory/compliance standards
- Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with marketing, content, and business teams to deliver impactful creative solutions
- Project Management: Handle multiple design projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and quality expectations
- Continuous Improvement: Stay updated with the latest design trends, tools, and creative best practices

TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES:
- Adobe Photoshop
- Adobe Illustrator
- Adobe In Design
- Adobe XD
- Figma
- Microsoft Power Point
- Typography
- Layout Design
- Color Theory
- Digital Design
- Print Design
- Brand Compliance
- Communication
- Stakeholder Coordination Experience: 1-3 Years

QUALIFICATIONS:
